title: The Game Show
tagline: The Game Show is an AI-powered Discord bot that organizes fun contests like joke-offs, with entries and prize payouts secured on Base via smart contracts. Contestants submit entries, pay fees, and AI judges pick winners—all automated, fair, and transparent.

description: The Game Host is an AI game show bot designed for Discord servers. It organizes creative contests—like joke competitions—where users submit their entries privately. Each submission is registered on a smart contract deployed on Base, ensuring transparency and fairness. Contestants pay a small entry fee, and after the contest ends, an AI jury evaluates the entries and selects the winner. The smart contract then releases the jackpot to the winner automatically. By blending AI-driven fun with blockchain transparency, The Game Host offers a unique, secure, and entertaining experience for all participants.
how_its_made: The project is built as a Discord bot using AgentKit by Coinbase to handle AI-powered contest organization and judging. For secure submission management, we leveraged Privy Server Wallets to generate cryptographic signatures, allowing participants to register their entries on a smart contract deployed on Base. Each entry is submitted via a private Discord thread, where the bot provides a signature that authorizes a transaction, including the entry fee. Once the AI jury, powered by AgentKit, evaluates the submissions, it selects a winner and submits the result to the smart contract, triggering the jackpot payout. The integration of Privy and Base ensures that contest entries and prize distribution are both tamper-proof and fully automated, while the AI adds a fun, interactive element to judging. This blend of AI and blockchain creates a transparent, trustless system for running community-driven contests on Discord.
